substrate.metadata_retrieval: HTTP200 from original USGS publisher on2026-10-02
substrate.publisher_rights: USGS current metadata declares CC0/public domain and redistribution with proper metadata/source attribution. Acknowledge USGS. Not for navigation.
metadata_conflicts: XML map projection says WGS1984/UTM10N while geodetic subsection says NAD83; use actual GeoTIFF-declared WGS84/UTM10N and retain uncertainty.
Metadata eastern bound -120.185163 overstates actual raster east -120.371431; actual native masks control coverage.
Ground-condition range2007–2009 and generic abstract1998–2014 differ from parent sonar2008/lidar2009–2010; no single acquisition year assigned.
Abstract says4 substrate classes but actual raster/VAT includes class5 hard anthropogenic material. Native codes and original SUBSTRATE/FULL_DESC definitions take precedence over generic abstract.
substrate.horizontal_accuracy: No verified quantitative class-grid error. Metadata camera GPS <3m is not a raster-accuracy guarantee.
substrate.classification_accuracy: No quantitative confusion matrix or per-cell confidence provided in reviewed metadata.

lineage.parent_method: Fugro Pelagos2008 sonar and USACE2009–2010 lidar, NOAA2013 TopoBathy compilation; character uses derivative rugosity and backscatter with video/sample-supervised training.
lineage.same_survey_as_depth_flag: true conservatively; do not count as independent confirmation. Exact pixel-to-H11952/H11953 survey-line provenance unresolved.
lineage.observational_scope: Supervised substrate interpretation, not ground-truth video at every pixel or proof of fish presence.

class_handling.1: fine to medium sediment -> normalized1 excluded
class_handling.2: mixed/coarse sediment/rock -> normalized2 hard-flat/mixed; no rugose-rock assertion
class_handling.4: coarser sediment/scour -> normalized1 excluded conservatively; original description retained
class_handling.5: anthropogenic hard-flat -> normalized2; never natural rugose class3; artificial identity retained in provenance binding
class_handling.nodata0: unknown; not sand or flat bottom

remaining_limits: No exact per-pixel H11952/H11953 lineage. Treat as shared evidence for confidence.
Original man-made class5/15 normalized to hard-flat2 and never hard-rugose3. Existing feature output carries generic habitat-candidate semantics, not a natural-reef assertion.
The binding activates on merge despite source candidate status; coordinator review and screening required.

overlap_summary.meaning: Evidence overlap, not new bathymetry, selected habitat or legally cleared area.
